class: A resume control only writes to answer files that do not exist yet
symptom: Resume could return success without notifying a waiting worker.
root_cause: The cockpit enumerated existing signal files instead of waiting notes. A waiting worker normally has no signal file until an owner sends a decision.
why_tests_missed: The existing endpoint test asserted only a successful JSON response, not the worker-visible signal artifact.
fix: Use the same waiting-note registry as the dashboard and create the corresponding Continue signal for a live waiting run.
prevention: Test the observable side effect of a UI control, not just its response status. A waiting marker and a response signal have different lifecycle roles.
